completion_code:
if self.purchasePending then
        return
    end

    local productId = 'starter_bundle'
    self.purchasePending = true
    self.ui:setPurchaseButtonEnabled(false)

    local finished = false
    local verifying = false
    local function finish(message)
        if finished then
            return false
        end
        finished = true
        self.purchasePending = false
        self.ui:setPurchaseButtonEnabled(true)
        if message then
            self.ui:showMessage(message)
        end
        return true
    end

    local ok, accepted = pcall(function()
        return self.store:purchase(productId, {
            onPurchased = function(receipt)
                if finished or verifying then
                    return
                end
                verifying = true
                self.store:validateReceipt(receipt, function(valid, transactionId)
                    if finished then
                        return
                    end
                    if not valid or type(transactionId) ~= 'string' or transactionId == '' then
                        finish('The purchase could not be verified.')
                        return
                    end

                    local callOk, delivered = pcall(function()
                        return self.inventory:grantOnce(transactionId, productId)
                    end)
                    if not callOk or not delivered then
                        finish('Purchase verified, but item delivery is pending.')
                        return
                    end
                    finish('Purchase complete.')
                end)
            end,
            onCancelled = function()
                finish('Purchase cancelled.')
            end,
            onFailed = function()
                finish('Purchase failed. Try again later.')
            end,
        })
    end)

    if not ok or not accepted then
        finish('The store could not start the purchase.')
    end
end
callback_handling: Handle purchase, cancellation, and failure callbacks separately, and use a completion guard so duplicate terminal callbacks cannot reset the flow twice. Validate each receipt once; reject invalid or missing transaction IDs, and report delivery failures distinctly from verification failures.
invocation_timing: Begin the purchase only in response to the player's starter-bundle action and only when no purchase is pending. Keep the button disabled while the store request and asynchronous receipt validation are in progress.
completion_instruction: Complete the purchase handler for the starter bundle. Prevent overlapping purchases, verify the returned receipt before delivery, use the transaction ID for idempotent inventory delivery, and restore the purchase button on success, cancellation, validation failure, or store errors.
reward_state_transition: Deliver the bundle only after receipt validation succeeds. Pass the validated transaction ID to an idempotent inventory operation so repeated delivery attempts cannot grant the same purchase twice.
